create_grounding_dino_image_processor: create a GroundingDinoImageProcessor to post-process object detection outputs into bounding boxes
post_process_object_detection: post-process GroundingDinoForObjectDetection raw outputs into final bounding boxes with confidence scores
scale_bounding_boxes_to_target_sizes: scale a batch of bounding boxes from relative [0,1] coordinates to absolute pixel coordinates for target image sizes
create_grounding_dino_image_processor_pi: create a GroundingDinoImageProcessorPil for PIL-based post-processing of GroundingDino object detection outputs
filter_object_detection_by_threshold: filter object detection predictions by confidence score threshold to keep only high-confidence bounding boxes
